propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to clarify that the key controls advisory duplicate-ticket suggestions rather than an internal overlap detection mechanism
Both the old TOML key and old environment variable name are maintained as permanent aliases with no planned removal date
The feature is undocumented in docs/config.md despite being opt-in and spending LLM tokens proportional to tracker size, creating a documentation defect

Backward compatibility is achieved via _ALIASES dict entry for TOML keys and _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES dict entry for environment variables, with precedence given to canonical names when both legacy and new forms are set
Two permanent deprecation registry rows and one _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES entry formalize the rename so warn_deprecated emits 'permanent alias' messaging rather than deprecation warnings
